---
name: list-fretum-bundles
description: List composed workflows (bundles) on the Fretum marketplace. A bundle chains multiple x402 endpoints into a single callable unit — e.g. "scrape company → enrich → draft outreach email". Use when the user or agent wants a multi-step workflow rather than a single endpoint, or says "find me a pipeline for X on Fretum", "what bundles are available", "browse workflows on Fretum".
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: false
allowed-tools: ["Bash(curl *)"]
---

# List Fretum Bundles

Bundles are pre-composed multi-endpoint workflows. One payment, one call — Fretum's runtime handles the sub-settlements to each step's merchant.

No authentication required for browsing.

## API

```
GET ${FRETUM_API_BASE:-https://app.fretum.ai}/api/bundles?category=<cat>&maxPrice=<usd>&limit=<n>
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `category` | enum | no | Same categories as listings: `research`, `scraping`, `enrichment`, `generation`, `translation`, `voice`, `outreach`, `data.feed` |
| `maxPriceUsd` | number | no | Filter bundles priced above this USD total |
| `limit` | number | no | Max results, default 10 |

## Input Validation

- `maxPriceUsd` must match `^\d+(\.\d+)?$`.
- `limit` must be a positive integer.
- `category`, if supplied, must match the enum exactly.

## Command

```bash
curl -sS "${FRETUM_API_BASE:-https://app.fretum.ai}/api/bundles?category=<CAT>&maxPrice=<MAX>&limit=<N>"
```

## Response Shape

```json
{
  "bundles": [
    {
      "id": "bndl_4p9",
      "name": "Outbound Lead Pipeline",
      "description": "Scrape → enrich → personalize outreach. Returns draft email.",
      "priceUsd": 0.12,
      "category": "outreach",
      "steps": [
        { "order": 1, "listingId": "lst_scraper", "name": "Site scraper" },
        { "order": 2, "listingId": "lst_enrich", "name": "Enrichment" },
        { "order": 3, "listingId": "lst_llm_writer", "name": "Email writer" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Examples

```bash
# Browse outreach bundles under $0.20
curl -sS "https://app.fretum.ai/api/bundles?category=outreach&maxPrice=0.20&limit=5"

# See all bundles
curl -sS "https://app.fretum.ai/api/bundles?limit=20"
```

## Next Steps

- Pick a bundle, inspect its `steps` to understand the pipeline.
- Run the whole bundle with `execute-fretum-bundle` — cheaper and simpler than composing each `listingId` manually.

## Error Handling

- HTTP 429 — rate-limited; back off.
- Empty `bundles` array — no matches; drop filters and retry.

# Browse outreach bundles under $0.20
curl -sS "https://app.fretum.ai/api/bundles?category=outreach&maxPrice=0.20&limit=5"

# See all bundles
curl -sS "https://app.fretum.ai/api/bundles?limit=20"
